#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int computeGCD(int a, int b) {
    int g = max(a, b);
    while (true) {
        if (a % g == 0 && b % g == 0) break;
        g--;
    }
    return g;
}

double computeDifference(double x, double y, double p, double q, double &num, double &den) {
    num = fabs(x * q - y * p);
    den = y * q;
    return num / den;
}

int main() {
    double x, y, n;
    double bestDiff = 1e9;
    int bestNum = 0, bestDen = 1;

    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    if (n > y) {
        int g = computeGCD((int)x, (int)y);
        if (g != 1) {
            x /= g;
            y /= g;
        }
        cout << (int)x << "/" << (int)y << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    for (int b = (int)n; b >= 1; --b) {
        double a_val = (x * b) / y;
        if (abs(a_val - floor(a_val)) < 1e-9) {
            bestNum = (int)a_val;
            bestDen = b;
            break;
        } else {
            double num1, den1, diff1;
            diff1 = computeDifference(x, y, floor(a_val), b, num1, den1);

            if (diff1 < bestDiff || (abs(diff1 - bestDiff) < 1e-9 && (int)floor(a_val) < bestNum)) {
                bestNum = (int)floor(a_val);
                bestDen = b;
                bestDiff = diff1;
            }

            double num2, den2, diff2;
            diff2 = computeDifference(x, y, ceil(a_val), b, num2, den2);

            if (diff2 < bestDiff || (abs(diff2 - bestDiff) < 1e-9 && (int)ceil(a_val) < bestNum)) {
                bestNum = (int)ceil(a_val);
                bestDen = b;
                bestDiff = diff2;
            }
        }
    }

    int g = computeGCD(bestNum, bestDen);
    if (g != 1) {
        bestNum /= g;
        bestDen /= g;
    }

    cout << bestNum << "/" << bestDen << endl;

    return 0;
}
